Tom — thanks for the clear ask. Quick summary and we'll follow up with a one-page term sheet attached.

High-level commercial framework (configurable):
- Core license: annual term license for the VPC runtime (billed annually or prepay).
- Platform fee: recurring managed/control-plane fee (can be amortized for accounting purposes — we can provide an annualized schedule).
- Migration retainer: one-time, typically 20-30% of year-1 ARR to cover onboarding engineering, privacy gating, and validation. We can split this across milestones (kickoff, staging, go-live).
- Support tiers: Bronze (business-hours), Silver (24x5), Gold (24x7 + named SLA/response). Pricing and onboarding credits differ by tier.

Flexibility options we can offer to reduce Year 1 cash:
- Move up to 50% of the retainer into milestone-payable credits tied to deliverables.
- Apply a term discount for a 3-year commit; typical band in this market is 15-25% depending on volume.
- Case-study / co-marketing can unlock an additional commercial credit.

Attached: Commercial_Term_Sheet_v3.xlsx (detailed split), SOW stub.

I'll loop Grace and Rishi — Grace can confirm the implementation credit, Rishi can confirm SLA/on-call costing.

Cheers,
Neha
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Team — quick internal note with a suggested counter we can present to Tom that balances P&L preferences and our unit economics:

Proposed customer-facing commercial structure:
- SKU split: Core on-prem license (annual term license) + Ops Platform Fee (recurring). Present as two-line items on the PO so they can capitalise the license and treat the platform fee as opex.
- Migration retainer: propose EUR 150k standard; allow split 40/30/30 across Milestone 1/2/3; refund up to EUR 30k back as implementation credit if they sign a 3-year commit and publish a short case study within 12 months.
- Discounting: offer 18% off the Ops Platform Fee in Year 1 for a 3-year commitment and upfront 50% of Year-1 invoice; reduce to 12% in Year 2. If they insist on 25% we need either a larger commit or marketing/partner concession.
- Support tranche: include Silver as baseline; Gold available as add-on. For EU deployments, include SOC2 + data residency SLA at Gold tier.
- CPI / renewal cap: cap increases at CPI + 2% for contract term (helps procurement).

Attachments: internal cost/price impact model (not attached here). I think the implementation credit gets us to Tom's Year-1 cash target without giving away broad discounting.

Grace
Head of Commercial Strategy, Redwood Inference
